description: This file defines a singleton helper class 'RefreshBroadcast' that provides a mechanism for broadcasting refresh requests within a Blazor application. It exposes an event 'RefreshRequested' and a method 'CallRequestRefresh' to trigger the event.

classes.name: RefreshBroadcast
classes.description: A singleton class used for broadcasting refresh requests across the application using an event.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Invokes the 'RefreshRequested' event to notify subscribers to refresh.
